Drawn over every app, like a real defect. Your wallpaper stays as it is.
Drawn on Hingegate\'s own live wallpaper, under your icons. No permission needed.
Your own wallpaper, swapped for a cracked copy of it on the inner screen and put back after. Needs a still (not live) wallpaper.
Settings opens next. Turn it on for Hingegate, then come back.
Android asks you next. If it doesn\'t ask (or you say no), Hingegate\'s notification settings open instead.
Needed to read your current wallpaper

Android only gives an app your current wallpaper image if it has All files access. Hingegate uses it only to read your current wallpaper, so it can show the same picture with a crack and put the original back. It never reads, changes or uploads any other file, and the app has no internet access.
Needed to draw the crack on top of other apps. The crack window ignores touches, so your taps go through to the app underneath. Nothing on your screen is read.
Optional. Only used to show the \"Hingegate is running\" notice of the background service. Hingegate works without it.
Needed to draw the crack over other apps
Off. Optional: the crack works without them.

Unfold the phone first: the inner screen\'s wallpaper is the one used.
Only the inner screen\'s home screen wallpaper changes. The lock screen and the cover screen are not touched.
This phone has one home screen wallpaper for both screens, so the cover screen shows Hingegate\'s copy too. The lock screen is not touched.
This mode doesn\'t follow screen rotation: the crack is drawn for the way your phone opens.
